headline: Stlican Shelf Flares Up As Weathered Expanse Sustains Fierce Clashes
war_summary: Combat activity has sharply escalated in Stlican Shelf, which logged three strategic base shifts within the past two hours amid mounting casualties, re-emerging as an active contested zone alongside Weathered Expanse. Weathered Expanse continues to endure ferocious fighting, recording two additional base transitions and over 4,400 combined casualties across the latest two-hour interval, with Frostmarch remaining the chief pivot of conflict. In Linn of Mercy, base exchanges have paused following earlier contention at Lathair, though casualty rates have accelerated heavily with more than 2,400 losses sustained in the last two hours. Meanwhile, strategic base captures have quieted across Fisherman's Row, Farranac Coast, and Mooring County, though Mooring County and Stonecradle continue to register punishing attritional volumes. Heavy frontline engagements persist without immediate base turnover across Callahan's Passage and Nevish Line, where surging enlistments and intense firefights maintain severe casualty rates on both sides.
